sections.Profile:
Space Orbit , released by D. Gottlieb & Co. in April 1972, is an electro-mechanical pinball machine designed by Ed Krynski with artwork by Gordon Morison.

- Manufacturer: D. Gottlieb & Co.
- Years made: 1972–1979
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Reels
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Wedgehead, Space, Original Theme, Horse Racing, 1970s, Sci-Fi
sections.Design Team:
- Design: Ed Krynski
- Art: Gordon Morison
- Art: Michele Martinelli
